title: Incident intake → dispatch with coverage gate
description: Score simultaneous incidents by severity and capability required, cut the queue to available units, and route the top band through an explicit coverage decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-crisis-01
  title: Incident intake → dispatch with coverage gate
  description: Score simultaneous incidents by severity and capability required, cut the queue to available
    units, and route the top band through an explicit coverage decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Assign resources across simultaneous incidents with every coverage gap named and authorized
    rather than created silently.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Incident reports and resource state
      summary: Incident reports and resource state
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - incident_reports
              - resource_status
              - coverage_requirements
              - mutual_aid_availability
            properties:
              incident_reports: {}
              resource_status: {}
              coverage_requirements: {}
              mutual_aid_availability: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-classify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-05
      name: Assess and score incoming incidents
      summary: Score and label every incoming item before anything is queued.
      role: Analyst building a common operating picture from conflicting reports.
      prompt: You are a Situation Assessment Analyst. You build a common operating picture from field
        reports, sensors, and public information, marking each element with its source, time, and confidence,
        and you keep conflicting reports visible rather than resolving them prematurely. You distinguish
        confirmed from reported, because acting on an unconfirmed report as if it were confirmed is how
        responses are misdirected.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - label
          - severity
          - confidence
          - rationale
        properties:
          label: {}
          severity: {}
          confidence: {}
          rationale: {}
    - id: n-filter
      kind: transform
      name: Drop out-of-scope items
      summary: keep incidents confirmed by at least one source and not already assigned
      config:
        operation: filter
        expression: keep incidents confirmed by at least one source and not already assigned
    - id: n-rank
      kind: transform
      name: Rank by urgency
      summary: sort by life_safety_severity descending, then by time_since_report descending
      config:
        operation: sort
        expression: sort by life_safety_severity descending, then by time_since_report descending
    - id: n-queue
      kind: transform
      name: Cut the actionable queue
      summary: take the first available_units incidents as the dispatch queue
      config:
        operation: slice
        expression: take the first available_units incidents as the dispatch queue
    - id: n-severity
      kind: condition
      name: Severity routing
      summary: Route on incident.severity selects one declared branch.
      config:
        expression: incident.severity selects one declared branch
        branches:
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
          - label: Standard
            when: standard
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-escalate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-01
      name: Dispatch with an explicit coverage-gap statement
      summary: Escalation path for the top band.
      role: Dispatcher matching incidents to resources under simultaneous demand.
      prompt: You are an Emergency Dispatch Coordinator. You assign resources by incident severity, capability
        required, travel time, and coverage left behind, and you state the coverage gap any assignment
        creates. You never strip an area to zero coverage without flagging it explicitly, because the
        second call is the one that becomes the inquiry.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-handle
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-03
      name: Standard assignment within existing coverage
      summary: Standard resolution path.
      role: Logistics officer tracking what is available, committed, and en route.
      prompt: You are a Resource & Logistics Officer. You maintain one authoritative picture of resources
        — available, committed, en route, out of service — reconciled across agencies, and you flag double-committed
        resources immediately. You state resource status with its as-of time, because in a multi-agency
        response the most dangerous number is a stale one presented as current.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-rejoin
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge after routing
      summary: Release whichever routed path completed.
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Duty officer authorizes assignments that create a coverage gap
      summary: Pause for the duty officer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Incident intake → dispatch with coverage gate deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-classify
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-2
      from: n-classify
      to: n-filter
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-3
      from: n-filter
      to: n-rank
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-4
      from: n-rank
      to: n-queue
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-5
      from: n-queue
      to: n-severity
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-6
      from: n-severity
      to: n-escalate
      kind: control
      condition: escalate
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-7
      from: n-severity
      to: n-handle
      kind: control
      condition: standard
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-8
      from: n-escalate
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-9
      from: n-handle
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-10
      from: n-rejoin
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-01-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
